de yang mya ngan ni sdug bsngal yin la/ de spangs pas mya ngan las 'das pa dang*/ zhi ba ni tsher ma rtsub pa dang bral ba ste/ nyon mongs pa med pa'o/ /dul ba ni 'khor bar kun tu sbyor pa'i las med pa dang*/ dri ma med pa ni skyon dang bral ba'o/ /'grel par sdug bsngal zhi bas rab tu phye pa'i phyir zhi ba lhag med myang 'das dang dbang po dul bas khyad par du byas pa'i phyir dul ba lhag bcas la 'chad do/ / 'dus byas rnams ni rnyings shing rgas pa dang*/ /'jig cing med par gyur pa yin pa las rga shi med pa mi rgas 'chi ba dang*/ mya ngan las 'das pa'i bde ba de ni zad nas slar 'khor bar skye ba mi srid pa'i phyir zad mi 'tshal ba/ sa chu me rlung nyi zla dang bral ba ste mu stegs gcer bu rnams ni nam mkha'i dbyings na thar pa'i grong khyer kha dog dkar po zhig yod par 'dod pa dang*/ dbang phyug pa dang*/ khyab 'jug pa rnams ni/ dbang phyug dang khyab 'jug gi gnas thar pa/ 'dod pa la sogs pa 'byung ba'am/ 'byung 'gyur las byung ba'i 'dus byas kyi bkod pa thar par 'dod pa de lta bur ma yin pa'i zag med dbyings kyi thar pa mchog thob par mdzod cig /mu stegs 'dod pa'i 'dus byas kyi gnas de 'dra ni thar pa ma yin te/ 'byung ba las gyur pas mthar 'jig pa'i phyir ro/ / rgyu sgom lam bshad pa la/ byang chub yan lag bdun la gdams pa/ rten 'brel bcu gnyis bsgom par gdams pa/ 'phags lam yan lag brgyad la gdams pa las dang po la dngos dang 'phros don las/ dang po ni/ dran dang chos rab 'byed dang brtson 'grus dang*/ /dga' dang shin tu sbyangs dang ting 'dzin dang*/ /btang snyoms 'di bdun byang chub yan lag ste/ /mya ngan 'das thob bgyid pa'i dge tshogs lags/ /dran pa yang dag byang chub kyi yan lag /chosarab tu rnam 'byed de shes rab dang*/ brtson 'grus dang*/ dga' ba dang*/ shin tu sbyangs pa dang*/ ting nge 'dzin dang*/ btang snyoms yang dag byang chub kyi yan lag ste/

'di rnams la byang chub kyi yan lag bdun zhes bya ste/ byang chub ni thar pa mya ngan las 'das pa yin la/ yan lag ni de dang rjes su mthun pa'i don te/ de sgrub pa'i thabs su gyur pa'i don yin te/ dge tshogs de rnams ni mya ngan las 'das pa thob pa'i thabs kyi nyams len yin pas 'bad pas sgom par byed do/ /de yang mdo sde rgyan dang dbus mtha' rnam 'byed las mthun par gsungs pa/ rang bzhin yan lag gnas yan lag /gsum pa nges 'byung yan lag ste/ /bzhi pa phan yon yan lag yin/ /rnam gsum nyon mongs med yan lag /ces pa rang bzhin ni dngos sam gtso bo'i don yin pas/ bdag med rtogs pa'i shes rab ni/ byang chub yan lag gi dngos gzhi gtso bo yin pas rang bzhin gyi yan lag dang*/ gnas kyi don ni rten gzhi'i don yin cing*/ dmigs yul bdag med pa'i don ma brjed pa dran par byed pa de las shes rab skye ba'i dran pa ni gnas kyi yan lag dang nges par 'byung ba ni gong nas gang du 'gro ba ste/ brtson 'grus kyi shes rab gong 'phel du byed pas brtson 'grus ni nges par 'byung ba'i yan lag dang*/ phan yon gyi don ni gnas skabs kyi phan yon te/ bdag med stong nyid kyi don rtogs pas dga' bde khyad par can 'dren par byed pa gnas skabs kyi phan yon yin pas dga' bde de ni phan yon gyi yan lag dang*/ shin tu sbyangs pa dang*/ ting nge 'dzin btang snyoms gsum ni nyon mongs med pa'i yan lag yin cing*/ dbus mtha' rnam 'byed las/ 'di la gzhi dang gnas dang ni/ /ngo bo nyid du brjod pa yin/ /ces pa/ gzhi ni rgyu'i don yin pas/ nyon mongs pa'i bag la nyal dang*/ rjes su mthun pa'i lus ngag yid gsum gyis kun tu spyaud pa ni gnas ngan len yin zhing*/ de nyid sngon 'bad pas bsgrims te bzlog dgos pa phyir sbyangs pa'i goms shugs kyis ched du ma bsgrims kyang mi 'byung zhing*/ gzhan yang rang gi dge ba la 'jug pa ni/

nyon mongs med pa 'byung ba'i rgyu yin te/ de nas shin tu sbyangs pa ni gzhi dang*/ gnas ni rten gzhir gyur pa'i don yin pas/ nyon mongs pa med pa'i ye shes yun ring du gnas pa ting nge 'dzin las byung ba'i ting nge 'dzin ni/ nyon mongs pa med pa'i gnas dang*/ nyon mongs pa med pa'i ye shes kyi ngo bo ni btang snyoms te/ ma chags mi sdang ba yin no/ / gnyis pa 'phros don byang chub yan lag bdun po de rnams kyi nang nas nyams len gyi gtso bo rnam 'byed shes rab dang*/ bsam gtan gyi ting nge 'dzin ston pa ni/ shes rab med la bsam gtan yod min te/ /bsam gtan med par yang ni shes rab med/ /gang la de gnyis yod pa'i srid pa yi/ /rgya mtsho gnag rjes lta bur 'tshal bar bgyi/ /thos bsam kyi shes rab phyin ci ma log pas mtshams sbyor ba med na/ gnas lus kyi don la mnyam par 'jog pa'i bsam gtan bsgom nus pa yod pa min cing*/ bsam gtan de med pas nyon mongs spong ba dang chos nyid mngon sum du mthong ba'i zag med sgom byung gi shes rab skye bar 'gyur ba med la/ thos bsam sgom gsum gyi shes rab dang gnas lugs yang dag pa'i don la mnyam par 'jog pa'i bsam gtan de gnyis rang gi rgyud la 'dzom par gyur na/ srid pa 'khor ba'i rgya mtsho brgal bar dka' ba nyid kyang*/ rmig rjes kyi chu lta bur 'bad rtsol kyis dka' ba med par brgal bar 'tshal ba ste nus pa yin no/ / de'i yang 'phros don 'dir shes rab kyis 'khor ba las grol bar bshad na/ lta ba thams cad shes rab kyi rigs yin pas 'jig rten mtha' ldan la sogs pa'i lta ba bcu bzhi po yang sgom pas grol bar 'gyur ba yin nam zhe na/ de ltar ma yin par ston pa ni/ lung ma bstan lta bcu bzhi 'jig rten na/ /nyi ma'i gnyen gyis rab gsungs gang dag lags/ /de dag rnams la bsam par mi bgyid de/ /de yi blo ni zhi bar bgyid ma lags/

/'jig rten mtha' ldan la sogs pa'i 'jig rten grags che ba'i lta ba bcu bzhi ni/ nyi ma'i gnyen yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas kyi lung ma bstan pa'i lta ba zhes pa'i tha snyad rab tu gsungs pa gang dag ste/ de ltar bu'i log pa'i shes rab kyi lta ba de dag rnams la ni/ bsam pa dang bsgom par bya ba ma yin te/ de'i blo ste rang gi sems rgyud kyi nyon mongs pa zhi bar bgyid pa ma yin pa'i phyir ro/ / lung du ma bstan pa'i lta ba bcu bzhi pa'i sdom ni/ bdag dang 'jig rten mtha' ldan dang*/ /mi ldan gnyis ka gnyis ka min/ /bdag dang 'jig rten rtag pa dang*/ /mi rtag gnyis ka gnyis ka min/ /de bzhin gshegs pa grongs phan chad/ /'byung dang mi 'byung gnyis gnyis min/ /bdag srog gcig dang tha dad ces/ /lung ma bstan lta bcu bzhi'o/ /de yang bdag dang 'jig rten mtha' ldan la sogs pa ni/ bdag dang phung po mnyam mi mnyam du 'dzin pa/ bong che chung gi tshad kyi mtha' dang*/ sngon dang phyi ma'i dus kyi mtha' dang ldan mi ldan/ de gnyis ka yin pa dang*/ gnyis ka min pa/ 'jig rten gyi khams yul gyi steng 'og phyogs mtshams kyi tshad mtha' ldan yin min du 'dzin dang*/ bskal ba chags 'jig la sogs pa'i dus kyi mtha' yod med de gnyis ka yin pa dang min par 'dzin pa/ bdag dang 'jin rten rtag pa dang mi rtag pa/ de gnyis gnyis ka yin min/ de bzhin gshegs pa phung po lhag ma med pa'i dbyings su mya ngan las 'das phan chad de thar pa nas slar 'khor bar ldog mi ldoga'abyung mi 'byung dang*/ de gnyis ka yin min/ bdag dang srog gcig mi gcig tu 'dzin pa ste/ lta ba bcu bzhi po de rnams kyi sgo nas mu stegs kun tu rgyu mang po zhig gis/ de bzhin gshegs pa dri ba zhus par dgos pa'i dbang gis re zhig tu lung ston pa ma gnang bas/ lta ba ngan pa de rnams lung ma bstan gyi lta ba zhes bya'o/ / rten 'brel bcu gnyis bsgom par gdams pa la/

rten 'brel lugs 'byung ni/ ma rig pa las las te de las ni/ /rnam shes de las ming dang gzugs rab 'byung*/ /de las skye mched drug ste de las ni/ /reg pa kun tu 'byung bar thub pas gsungs/ /reg pa las ni tshor ba kun 'byung ste/ /tshor ba'i gzhi las sred pa 'byung bar 'gyur/ /sred las len pa skye bar 'gyur ba ste/ /de las srid pa srid las skye ba lags/ /skye ba yod na mya ngan na rga dang*/ / 'dod pas phongs dang 'chi bas 'jigs sogs kyis/ /sdug bsngal phung po shin tu che 'byung ste/ /ma rig pa'i rten 'brel las las te/ 'du byed kyi rten 'brel 'byung*/ de las ming dang gzugs kyi rten 'brel rab tu 'byung bar 'gyur/ de las skye mched drug gi rten 'brel 'byung ste/ de dag las reg pa'i rten 'brel kun tu 'byung bar thub pas gsungs la/ reg pa de las ni tshor ba'i rten 'brel kun tu 'byung ste/ tshor ba'i gzhi zhes pa ni tshor ba yang yin la/ sred pa la sogs pa 'byung ba'i gzhi yin pas gzhi mthun bsdu ba'i sgras bstan pa yin/ de las srid pa'i rten 'brel 'byung bar 'gyur/ srid pa de las len pa'i rten 'brel skye bar 'gyur/ de las srid pa'i rten 'brel 'byung bar 'gyur/ srid pa de las skye ba'i rten 'brel 'byung 'gyur ba lags shing*/ de las rga shi'i rten 'brel 'byung ba ste gang skye ba yod pa na mya ngan dang*/ na ba dang*/ rgas pa dang*/ 'dod pa'i phongs pa dang*/ 'chi ba la sogs pa'i 'jig pa rnam pa sna tshogs kyi sdug bsngal gyi phung po shin tu che ba mi bzad pa 'byung bar 'gyur ro/ / rten 'brel lugs ldog mtshon byed tsam bstan pa ni/ skye ba 'gags pas 'di kun 'gags par 'gyur/ /zhes pa skye ba 'gags pas rga shi 'gags pa dang*/ de bzhin du srid pa 'gags pas skye ba 'gags pa nas/ ma rig pa 'gags pas 'du byed 'gags pa'i bar du lugs ldog tu sbyar bar bya'o/

/ rten 'brel gyi che ba bstan pa ni/ rten cing 'brel bar 'byung 'di rgyal ba yi/ /gsung gi mdzod kyi gces pa zab mo ste/ /gang gis 'di ni yang dag mthong ba des/ /sangs rgyas de nyid rig pas rnam mchog mthong*/ /rten cing 'brel bar 'byung ba'i gtam 'di ni rgyal ba yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas kyi gsung dam pa'i chos kyi bang mdzod chen po'i gces pa'i snying po dang*/ rtogs dka' zhing rtogs na don chen por 'gyur bas zab mo ste/ gang gi rten 'brel gyi don ni yang dag par phyin ci ma log par mthong ba de ni bden pa bzhi'i de kho na nyid rig cing rnam pa mchog ste ma nor ba bcu drug la sogs pa mngon sum du mthong ba yin la de ni tshogs rgya chen po dang ldan na sangs rgyas dang*/ 'bring du bsags par rang rgyal/ chung ngur bsags pa nyan thos dgra bcom par 'gyur ro/ / 'dir spyi don cung zad brjod na/ ma rig 'du byed rnam shes dang*/ /ming gzugs skye mched reg pa dang*/ /tshor ba sred len srid pa dang*/ skye ba rga shi bcu gnyis so/ /'dir rten 'brel gyi ngo bo/ /dbye ba yan lag bcu gnyis ngos bzung ba/ de dag skye ba gsum la ji ltar 'khor ba'i tshul rnams las/ dang po ni rkyen las byung ba'i ngo bo yin te/ mthun pa'i rgyu rkyen sna tshogs la 'bras bu 'byung ba'i don yin la/ gnyis pa la/ ngo bo'i dbye ba ni/ kun nas nyon mongs kyi rten 'brel dang*/ rnam byang gi rten 'brel gnyis las/ dang po ni/ ma rig pa'i rkyen gyis 'du byed 'byung ba nas/ skye ba'i rkyen gyis rga shi 'byung ba'i bar du sbyar ba'o/ /gnyis pa ni/ ma rig pa 'gags pas 'du byed 'gags pa nas/ skye ba 'gags pas rga shi 'gags pa'i bar du'o/ /

rtogs byed kyi shes pas rten 'brel sgom tshul dang rtog tshul la dbye na/ lugs 'byung lugs ldog gnyis las/ dang po ni/ ma rig pa las 'du byed 'byung ba dang*/ ma rig pa 'gags pas 'du byed 'gags pa nas skye ba las rga shi 'byung ba dang*/ skye ba 'gags pas rga shi 'gags pa'i bar lugs 'byung du bsam pa dang*/ gnyis pa ni/ skye ba las rga shi 'byung ba dang*/ skye ba 'gags pas rga shi 'gags pa nas/ ma rig pa'i bar du sbyar te go rim ldog pa'i tshul gyis bsgom pa'o/ / rnam gzhag tha dad kyi dbye ba la/ skad cig ma'i rten 'brel/ rgyun chags pa'i rten 'brel/ gnas skabs pa'i rten 'brel/ 'brel ba can gyi rten 'brel rnams las/ dang po ni/ ma rig pas kun nas bslangs pa'i dge mi dge'i las gang byed kyang*/ las de byed pa po'i sems dang lus la dus skad cig mar rten 'brel bcu gnyis tshang bar brtsi ba yin la/ rgyun chags pa'i rten 'brel ni/ 'khor ba thog ma med pa nas da lta'i bar du rten 'brel gyi 'khor lo gcig mthud rgyun ma chad par byung ba dang*/ phyis kyang 'khor ba mtha' med pa'i bar du gnyen pos ma bcom na rgyun mi 'chad par 'byung ba'o/ / gnas skabs pa'i rten 'brel ni 'og tu 'chad par 'gyur ro/ /'brel ba can gyi rten 'brel ni sems can kho na la sbyar na/ las dang nyon mongs pa sdug bsngal rnams gcig las gcig 'byung ba phan tshun 'brel ba dang*/ bem chos la sbyar na sa bon las myu gu 'byung zhing*/ myu gu las sa bon 'byung ba sogs rgyu 'bras 'brel ba dang*/ brtan g.yo gnyis ka thun mong du sbyar na/ sems can gyi las dang nyon mongs pa las 'jig rten gyi khams kyi snang ba 'byung zhing grub pa dang*/ 'jig rten gyi khams la brten cing dmigs pas sems can gyi las dang nyon mongs pa gsog par byed pa'i snod bcud thams cad 'brel ba can du gyur pa ste/ 'brel ba can gyi rten 'brel la ni rnam pa brgyad yod par theg pa chen po'i chos mngon pa las gsungs so/

/ yan lag bcu gnyis kyi ngo bo ni/ ma rig pa la de kho nyid la rmongs pa'i ma rig pa dang*/ las 'bras la rmongs pa'i ma rig pa gnyis las/ dang po ni/ bdag med pa'i don mi shes pas rmongs pa ste/ des ni mi dge ba dang zag bcas thams cad kun nas slong bar byed cing*/ las 'bras la rmongs pa'i ma rig pa ni/ dge mi dge las 'bras bu bde sdug 'byung ba mi shes pa ste/ des ni mi dge ba rnams kho na kun nas slong bar byed do/ /'du byed la ngo bo ni lus ngag yid kyi las gsum gang rung zhig la dbye na bsod nams kyi las/ bsod nams ma yin pa'i las/ mi g.yo ba'i las gsum las/ dang po'i 'dod khams kyi dge ba dang*/ gnyis pa ni mi dge ba thams cad yin/ gsum pa ni bsam gtan dang gzugs med de khams gong ma gnyis thob par byed pa'i las yin pas dge ba dang*/ 'jig rten pa dang*/ mnyam pa pa ste khyad chos gsum ldan yin no/ / lung ma bstan gyi las/ dge ba'i nang nas zag med kyi las ni 'du byed kyi yan lag tu mi 'gyur ro/ /rnam shes la rgyu'i rnam shes dang*/ 'bras bu'i rnam shes te/ de yang kun gzhi rnam shes yin cing*/ rgyun gcig kho na yin pas rnam shes rang gi ngos nas gsal mi gsal dang*/ stobs che chung med kyang*/ rnam shes la las kyi sa bon thebs pa nas ma shi ba'i bar du las kyi bag chags mi gsal zhing stobs chung bar yod pas rgyu dang*/ bar do dang rang nyid mtshams sbyar ba na/ las kyi sa bon smin pa'i tshul gyis stobs dang ldan zhing gsal bar 'gyur ba yin no/ /ming gzugs kyi rten 'brel la/ ming ni ming bzhi'i phung po ste/ tshor ba/ 'du byed/ 'du shes rnam par shes pa'i phung po bzhi po gzhan la rig par byed pa na/ dbang shes la bstan du med pa'i ming kho nas ston par byed pa yin pas/ gzugs kyi phung po ni/ mig gi rnam par shes pa la sogs pa la dngos su bstan du yod pas gzugs zhes brjod de/

de ltar phung po lnga ni ming gzugs kyi rten 'brel yin no/ /skye mched drug ni mig gi skye mched nas yid kyi skyai mched kyi bar drug go /reg pa'i rten 'brel ni/ yul dbang rnam shes gsum 'dus pa la brten nas shes pa rnam par 'gyur ba ste/ de yang mig gi 'dus te rig pa nas yid kyi 'dus te reg pa'i bar drug go /tshor ba'i rten 'brel la ni/ mig gi 'dus te reg pa'i tshor ba nas yid kyi dus te reg pa'i tshor ba'i bar drug dang*/ de re re la yang bde sdug btang snyoms gsum gyis tshor ba myong ba'i/ dbye bas bco brgyad du 'gyur ba las gang yang rung ba zhig yin no/ /sred pa'i rten 'brel ni tshor ba las 'byung bas/ bde ba la sngar yod dang mi 'bral bar sred pa dang*/ sngar med 'byung bar 'dod pas sred pa/ sdug bsngal la 'bral bar 'dod pa dang slar mi 'byung bar 'dod pas sred pa/ btang snyoms la gnas par 'dod pas sred pa'o/ / len pa'i rten 'brel ni/ sred pa'i yul 'tshol bar 'dod pa ste/ de la 'dod pa nye bar len pa dang*/ tshul zhugs nye bar len pa dang*/ lta ba nye bar len pa dang*/ bdag tu smra bar nye bar len pa rnams las/ 'dod pa nye bar len pa ni/ 'dod pa'i yul rnams la sred nas 'tshol bar 'dod pa dang*/ tshul zhugs nye bar len pa ni phyi ma mtho ris kyi phung po bde ba don du gnyer pa tsam gyis tshul khrims dang brtul zhugs len par 'dod pa yin no/ / lta ba nye bar len pa ni tshe 'dir rnyed pa bkur bsti grags pa thob par 'dod pa dang*/ phyi ma'i mtho ris kyi bde ba don du gnyer bas ngan pa'i lta ba 'dzin par 'dod pa dang*/ bdag tu smra bar nye bar len pa ni/ bdag rgyud kyi phung po sred pas de'i phun tshogs 'dod pa ste/ dngos po la ser snas mkho tshags su byed 'dod lta bu dang*/ bdag nyid sgrog par byed pa dang*/ phung po bzang po 'dod pas bsam gtan gzugs med kyi ting nge 'dzin bsgom par 'dod pa tshun chad do/

/nyer len bzhi po chos mngon gnyis su 'di las rnam grangs gzhan du gsungs kyang gnad gcig nyid do/ / srid pa'i rten 'brel ni/ skye ba'i srid par nying mtshams sbyor ba'i las mthu can du gyur pa ni srid pa ste/ de la gsum las/ las kyi srid pa ni stobs chung ba dang*/ 'chi ba'i srid pa ni stobs 'bring dang*/ nying mtshams sbyor ba'i srid pa ni stobs chen por gyur pa'o/ /skye ba'i rten 'brel ni/ mngal skyes/ rdzus skyes/ drod gsher skyes/ sgong skyes kyi skye ba rnams so/ /rga shi'i rten 'brel phung po 'gyur bas rgas pa dang*/ na ba dang*/ mya ngan dang*/ smre sngags 'don pa/ sdug bsngal ba/ yid mi bde ba la sogs pa nas 'chi ba'i bar du'o/ / de ltar rten 'brel bcu gnyis ni/ lam gsum mam/ kun nas nyon mongs pa gsum gyis bsdus pa yin te/ nyon mongs kyi lam dang*/ las kyi lam dang*/ sdug bsngal gyi lam gsum mo/ /yang na kun nas nyon mongs pa gsum ste/ nyon mongs kyis kun nas/ nyon mongs las kyi kun nas nyon mongs/ sdug bsngal gyis kun nas nyon mongs rnams so/ /de yang klu sgrub nyid kyis/ dbu ma rten 'brel snying po las/ dang po brgyad pa dgu nyon mongs/ /gnyis pa bcu pa las yin te/ /lhag ma bdun ni sdug bsngal lo/ /zhes pa dang po ma rig pa/ brgyad pa sred pa/ dgu pa len pa ni nyon mongs dang*/ gnyis pa 'du byed dang*/ bcu pa srid pa ni las yin no/ /lhag ma rnam par shes pa la sogs pa lnga dang*/ skye ba rga shi gnyis te bdun po ni sdug bsngal zhes bya'o/ / gsum po dag las gnyis 'byung ste/ /gnyis las bdun 'byung bdun las kyang*/ /gsum 'byung srid pa'i 'khor lo 'di/ /nyid ni yang dang yang du 'khor/ /zhes pa nyon mongs pa las las 'byung*/ las las sdug bsngal 'byung*/ de'i mtha' zad par mi 'gyur bar slar yang sdug bsngal las nyon mongs pa 'byung ba'i rgyun chags par 'khor ba yin no/

/de la las nyon yan lag lnga ni rgyu dang*/ sdug bsngal yan lag bdun ni 'bras bus bsdus so/ / bzhi pa tshe gsum la sbyar ba ni/ gnas skabs pa'i rten 'brel kho na'i dbang du byas nas tshe gsum la sbyor ba yin te/ mngon pa mdzod las/ sngon dang phyi mthar gnyis gnyis dang*/ /bar du brgyad yongs rdzogs ldan la/ /zhes pa skye ba sngon ma la ma rig pa dang*/ 'du byed gnyis sbyar*/ skye ba phyi ma la skye ba dang rga shi gnyis sbyar*/ skye ba bar pa la rnam par shes pa nas srid pa'i bar gyi rten 'brel gyi yan lag brgyad po sbyar ro/ /de ltar tshe gsum la sbyar pa'i dgos pa ni/ sngon dang phyi mtha' bar dag la/ /rmongs pa rnam par ldog phyir ro/ /zhes pa tshe bar pa da ltar gyi skye ba yin pa'i dbang du byas nas/ de'i rgyu tshe snga ma yin par bstan pas/ de yang skye ba sngon ma sogs skye ba'i sngon mtha' med par shes pas/ skye ba'i sngon gyi mtha' ma rmongs pa ldog par 'gyur zhing*/ skye ba phyi ma da ltar gyi skye ba'i 'bras bu yin par bstan pas/ de'i yang tshe phyi ma sogs gnyen pos ma bcom na skye ba mtha' med du shes pas skye ba'i phyi mtha' la rmongs pa sel bar 'gyur ro/ / da ltar gyi skye ba tshe sngon ma'i 'bras bu dang phyi ma'i rgyun yin pa shes pa na/ rgyu med las byung ba dang*/ byed pa'i skyes bus byas par 'dod pa la sogs pa'i rmongs pa ldog par 'gyur ro/ / tshe gsum la ji ltar sbyor ba'i tshul ni sngon la nyon mongs pa kho na la gnas pa'i skabs ni ma rig pa'i yan lag yin/ 'du byed kyi nang du rgyu'i rnam shes kyang bsdus te/ nyon mongs pas kun nas bslangs pa'i las la spyod bzhin pa dang*/ spyad zin pa ni 'du byed kyi yan lag ste/ de gnyis tshe dang po'i khongs su bsdus pa dang*/ bar do dang nying mnyam sbyor ba'i gnas skabs na rnam par shes pa ni yod la/ gzugs kyi phung po med pas rnam par shes pa'i yan lag ces bya/

bar do'i rnam par shes pa ma'i mngal du zhugs te dkar dmar sems gsum 'dres pa na/ ming bzhi dang*/ gzugs kyi phung po tsam ni yod la/ mig sogs skye mched bzhi ma dod pas/ ming gzugs kyi yan lag ces bya/ zla ba lnga rdzogs na sngar yod lus dang yid kyi skye mched steng du/ mig gi skye mched la sogs pa bzhi mngon du gyur pas skye mched drug tshang zhing*/ gzugs sogs kyi yul la spyod par mi nus pas skye mched kyi yan lag ces bya/ btsas pa nas dbang po drug yul la 'jug pas reg pa yod kyang*/ tshor ba bde sdug gi rgyu mi shes pas reg pa'i rten 'brel gyi yan lag ces bya/ smra ba dang 'gro ba la sogs pa'i gnas skabs nas bde sdug gi rgyu shes pa la sogs pa'i tshor ba rags pa yod kyang*/ 'khrig pa la sred pa'i sems med pa ni tshor ba'i rten 'brel gyi yan lag ces bya/ lo bcu gnyis la sogs pa'i gnas skabs na 'khrig pa la sred pa'i sems yod cing spyod mi nus pas/ sred pa shas che la len pa shes chung bas srid pa'i rten 'brel gyi yan lag yin/ bcu drug pa la sogs pa na 'khrigs pa'i bya ba la 'jug pas sred pa'i yul la spyod pas len pa shas cher yod cing*/ nar ma lon pas bsam bzhin pa'i lus shugs can mang po gsog par mi byed pas len pa'i yan lag dang*/ nar lon pa nas 'chi ba'i bar du dge sdig gi las shugs che bar spyod pas srid pa'i yan lag ste/ yan lag brgyad po de rnams ni tshe bar pa la tshang pa yin*/ bar do'i srid pa dang nying mtshams sbyor ba'i srid pa gnyis skye ba'i nang du bsdus te/ ma'i mngal du gnas pa nas phyir byung ba'i bar ni skye ba'i rten 'brel gyi yan lag dang*/ skyes nas phung por 'gyur ba la sogs pa'i 'chi ba'i bar ni rga shi'i rten 'brel gyi yan lag yin no/ / yan lag gnyis po de tshe gsum pa'i gnas skabs su sbyar ro/ /de yang 'phags pa klu sgrub gyi rjes 'brang rnams rten 'brel gyi 'khor lo tshe gsum la brtsi ba shas che ba 'phags thogs med ni skye ba gnyis la rdzogs par bzhed pa shas che ste/

de yang*/ ma rig pa nas len pa'i bar dgu po rnams ni skye ba snga ma la tshang ba dang*/ phyi ma gsum ni skye ba rjes ma la sbyor bar mdzad pa yin no/ / tshul 'di ni ma rig pa dang 'du byed ni 'phen pa'i yan lag dang*/ rnam shes la sogs pa lnga ni 'phags pa'i yan lag yin no/ /sred len srid pa gsum ni 'grub byed kyi yan lag dang*/ skye ba rga shi gnyis ni 'grub pa'i yan lag ste yan lag bzhis bsdus pa'o/ / de dag ni kun rjob rten 'brel yin la/ re zhig don dam gyi rten 'brel ni/ gnas skabs kyi don dam ste/ dper na 'du byed kyi yan lag /bdag dang*/ gzhan dang gnyis dang*/ gnyis ka dang*/ gnyis min las mi skye yang ma brtags ma dpyad pa'i ngor ma rig pa'i rkyen gyis 'du byed ces tshogs pa de las snang ba de tsam shar ba mi 'gog pa lta bu lte 'dir rgyas par ma brjod do/ / 'phags lam yan lag brgyad bshad pa la/ dngos dang 'phros don gnyis las/ dang po la/ 'phags lam yan lag brgyad ngos bzung ba ni/ yang dag lta dang 'tsho dang rtsol ba dang*/ /dran dang ting 'dzin ngag dang las mtha' dang*/ /yang dag rtog nyid lam gyi yan lag brgyad/ /'di ni zhi bar bgyi slad bsgom par bgyi/ /de yang yang dag pa'i lta ba dang*/ de bzhin du sbyar te 'tsho ba dang*/ rtsol ba dang*/ dran pa dang*/ ting nge 'dzin dang*/ ngag dang*/ las mtha' dang*/ yang dag pa'i rtog pa nyid de/ de rnams ni 'phags lam yang yin la/ yan lag kyang yin pas/ 'phags lam gyi yan lag brgyad do/ / de ni nyon mongs pa dang sdug bsngal ma zhi ba zhi bar byed pa dang*/ zhi ba rnams shin tu mthar phyin par bya ba'i slad du bsten par bya'o/ /gzhung 'dir go rim de bzhin du bstan pa ni sdeb sbyor gyi dbang gis yin gyi/ gzhan du na lta rtog ngag las 'tsho rtsol dran ting brgyad ces sdom du bya ste/ mdo las go rim de ltar du gsungs so/ /de yang yang dag pa'i lta ba ni gnas lugs kyi don phyin ci ma log par rtogs pa'i zag med kyis shes rab yin/

yang dag pa'i rtogs pa ni gnas lugs kyi don rang gis rtogs pa ltar gzhan gyis kyang rtogs par 'dod pa'i gzhan phan gyi sems yin/ yang dag pa'i ngag ni/ gnas lugs kyi don rang gis rtogs pa ltar gzhan la ngag tshig dri ma med pas ston par byed pa yin/ yang dag pa'i las kyi mtha' ni/ lus ngag yid gsum gyis mi dge ba phra mo tsam yang spangs pa'i dge ba'i spyod pa khyad par can la gnas pa yin/ yang dag pa'i 'tsho ba ni/ log pa'i 'tsho ba spangs nas chos dang mthun pa'i 'tsho ba ste rab tu byung ba'i dbang du byas na zas bsod snyoms pa dang*/ gos phyag dar khrod kyi 'tsho ba la sogs pa sbyangs ba'i yon tan bcu gnyis la gnas pa lta bu yin no/ /yang dag pa'i rtsol ba ni brtson 'grus yin cing*/ dran pa dang*/ ting nge 'dzin te 'phags lam yan lag gsum po de ni byang chub yan lag bdun gyi skabs su bstan pa dang 'dra'o/ /'dir yang dag ces pa so so skye bo la med pa'i 'phags pa'i lam yin pa'i phyir de ltar brjod do/ /

'phags pa'i lam yan lag brgyad du grangs nges bstan pa ni/ dbus mtha' rnam 'byed las/ yongs su dpyod dang go byed dang*/ /rnam gsum gzhan yid ches par byed*/ /mi mthun phyogs kyi gnyen por ni*/ /lam gyi yan lag de brgyad do/ /zhes pa gnas lugs kyi don blo gros kyis yongs su dpyod nus pa zhig dgos pa lta ba dang*/ gnas lugs kyi don de gzhan gyis go zhing rtogs par byed dgos pa rtogs pas 'grub cing*/ ngag dang las dang 'tsho ba gsum gyis gzhan yid ches par byed pa dang*/ rtsol ba dang*/ dran pa/ ting nge 'dzin gsum gyis mi mthun phyogs kyi gnyen po byed pa ste/ lha dang tshul khrims yod byad smyung*/ /gzhan la rnam par rig byed 'dod/ /nyon mongs nye ba'i nyon mongs dbang*/ /mi mthun phyogs kyi gnyen po'o/ /de yang rang rig ni gnas lugs kyi don rtogs pa gzhan ngag tshig dri ma med par bstan pas yang dag pa'i lta ba dang ldan par yid ches par 'gyur ba dang*/ spyod pa bde ba la gnas pas tshul khrims dang ldan par yid ches pa dang*/ yang dag pa'i 'tsho ba la gnas pas yo byad smyung bar yid ches par byed pas/ ngag las 'tsho ba gsum ni gzhan yid ches par byed pa'i yan lag yin no/ / rtsol pa brtson 'grus kyis ni zhe sdang la sogs pa rtsa ba'i nyon mongs pa 'joms par byed/ dran pas ni mnyam bzhag gi gnas su byings rgod la sogs pa nye ba'i nyon mongs pa 'joms pa'i gnyen po byed/ ting nge 'dzin gyi ni dbang la bar du gtsod pa'i snyoms 'jug gi sgrib pa rnams 'joms pa'i gnyen po byed pa yin te/ bsam gtan dang gzugs med pa'i snyoms par 'jug pa dgu dang*/ rdzu 'phrul la sogs pa mngon par shes pa drug dang*/ zad par bcu dang zil gyis gnon pa brgyad la sogs pa rnams thob pa la bar du gcod pa'i snyoms 'jug gi sgrib pa rnams gnyen po ting nge 'dzin gyis bcom nas/ bsam gtan dang*/

gzugs med pa'i snyoms 'jug thob cing*/ de dag thob pas rdzu 'phrul dang*/ mngon shes rnams la dbang 'byor pa thob pa yin no/ / 'phags lam yan lag brgyad po de ni bden pa bzhi sgom pa'i thabs dang*/ 'phags pa'i lam dngos yin par bstan pa ni/ skye 'di sdug bsngal sred pa zhes bgyi ba/ /'di ni de yi kun 'byung rgya chen te/ /'di 'gog pa ni thar pa lags te lam/ /de thob 'phags lam yan lag de brgyad lags/ khams gsum 'khor ba thams cad sdug bsngal yin yang*/ de'i gtso bo skye ba 'di yin cing*/ las nyon thams cad kun 'byung yin yang*/ skye ba la mtshams sbyor ba'i nyon mongs ni srid pa zhes bya ba dga' ba'i chags pa yin pas/ de ni sdug bsngal 'di yi rgyu kun 'byung thams cad kyi gtso bo rgya chen por gyur pa yin te/ de ltar las nyon sdug bsngal gsum po 'di 'gags pa'i shugs kyis sems nyid spros bral de ni thar pa 'gog pa'i bden pa yin cing*/ de thob par byed pa'i lam ni 'phags pa'i lam yan lag brgyad po de yin pa las/ de rnams kyi nang nas kyang lam gyi gtso bo yang dag pa'i lta ba yin no/ / 'phros don ni/ de ltar 'phags pa'i bden pa bzhi po dag /mthong bar bgyi slad rtag tu brtson par bgyi/ /pang na dpal gnas khyim pa rnams kyis kyang*/ /shes pas nyon mongs chu bo las brgal bgyi/ /bdag med pa'i don gtso bor gyur pa'i bden bzhi mi rtag la sogs bcu drug gi don bsgom par bya zhing*/ de yang khams gsum 'khor ba 'di dag sdug bsngal du shes par byas nas/ sdug bsngal gyi rgyu las nyon kun 'byung rnams spaung ba dang*/ sdug bsngal thams cad zad pa'i mtha'i ye shes 'gog pa thob par byed dgos pas kun 'byung yong ba dang*/ 'gog pa thob pa'i thabs lam gyi nyams len la slob dgos so/ /de ltar 'phags pa'i bden pa bzhi'i don mngon sum du mthong bar bgyi ba'i slad du rtag tu brtson pa chen po nas 'phags pa'i lam rgyud la ma skyes par nan tan du bya dgos shing*/

'phags pa'i lam thob pa na shugs 'byung gis yon tan gong du 'phel bar 'gyur ro/ / de ltar na yang bden pa bzhi'i don bsgoms nas mngon sum du rtogs par 'gyur ba ni/ khyim nas khyim med par rab tu byung ste tshul khrims la gnas pa 'dod pa chung zhing chog shes pa/ dben pa la gnas shing g.yeng ba med pa de dag gis rtse gcig tu bsgom pas thob pa yin gyi/ rgyal srid kyi bya bas rnam par g.yeng ba la sogs pa bdag cag khyim pa rnams kyis cung zad re bsgoms pas don rtogs par mi 'gyur snyam na ma yin te/ sngon sangs rgyas nyid bzhugs pa'i dus na rgyal po gzugs can snying po dang*/ khyim bdag mgon med zas sbyin la sogs pa yang dpal dang longs spyaud kyi 'byor pa phun sum tshogs pa rang gi pang na gnas pa bzhin du longs spyod pa'i khyim pa dag kyang*/ 'dod yon la spyaud bzhin par yang dag pa'i lta ba shes rab rgyud la skyes nas nyon mongs pa'i chu bo las brgal te/ 'phags pa'i lam thob pa yin no/ / yang sngon byung ba de rnams ni bsod nams kyi tshogs rgya chen por bsags pa dbang po rno ba yin la/ skal ba chung ba bdag cag rnams kyis ni de ltar du bsgrub par mi nus so ce na/ gang dag chos mngon bgyis pa de dag kyang*/ / gnam las babs pa ma lags lo tog bzhin/ /sa rum nas 'thon ma lags de dag sngon/ /nyon mongs rag las skye bo kho nar bas/ /gang dag khyim pa'i rten la 'dod yon dang bcas pas chos nyid kyi don mngon sum du bgyis pa de dag kyang*/ sngon thog ma nyid nas rang grub tu bsod nams ches che ba dbang po rno ba zhig rgyu med par gnam babs su byung ba dang*/ sa 'og nas myu gu thon pa bzhin du byung ba ma yin te/ sngon gyi gang zag de rnams kyang thog mar nyon mongs la rag las pa ste nyon mongs kyi dbang du gyur pa/ dbang po rtul ba'i so so skye bo phal ba zhig ka yin kyang*/

dge ba'i lam la rim gyis goms par byas pas rgyud smin nas phyis dbang po rnon por gyur te bden pa mthong ba yin pas sgyid lug par mi bya'o/ / da ni gong du bshad pa thams cad kyi spyi'i don bsdus pa ni/ bsnyengs dang bral ba mang dus gsol ci 'tshal/ phan pa'i gdams ngag don po 'di lags te/ khyod kyi thugs dul mdzod cig bcom ldan gyis/ /sems ni chos kyi rtsa ba lags par gsungs/ /bsnyengs pa ni 'jigs pa'i don yin pas/ rgyal po ni sa'i dbang phyug dang ldan pas tshe 'dir 'jigs pa dang bral ba dang*/ sdig pa spangs shing dge ba la spyad pas skye ba phyi mar yang sdug bsngal gyi 'jigs pa dang bral bas/ bsnyengs dang bral zhes rgyal po la bos nas/ sngar rjes dran drug nas 'phags lam yan lag brgyad la sogs pa'i bar du bstan pa de tsam gyis don ston pa yin pas/ khyed la da ni mang po gsol bar bgyi mi dgos shing ci 'tshal te mi 'tshal lo/ / mdor bsdu na/ gang zhig rgyud la brten na phan pa dang bde ba'i rgyur 'gyur pa'i gdams ngag rnams kyi don gyi snying po gtso bo ni/ sems rgyud kyi nyon mongs pa sbyong ba 'di lags pas/ rgyal po khyod kyis rang gi thugs thul bar mdzod cig /bcom ldan 'das kyis sems thul ba ni chos thams cad kyi rtsa ba lags par gsungs te/ sems dul ba ni legs pa ste/ /zhes dang rang gi sems ni yongs su 'dul/ /'di ni sangs rgyas bstan pa yin/ /ces gsungs so/ /sems dul ba la ni gong du bshad pa'i chos kyi rnam grangs mtha' yas pa bsgrub dgos na/ de ltar mi nus so zhe na/ khyed la de skad gdams pa gang lags te/ /bas par dge slong gis kyang bgyi bar dka'/ /'di la gang zhig spyaud pa'i ngo bo de'i/ /yon tan bsten pas sku tshe don yod mdzod*/ /gong du bstan pa mtha' dag ni bsal te ma lus pa yongs su rdzogs par so so skye bo'i gnas skabs su ni dge slong rnams kyis kyang bgyi bar dka' ba yin te/

'phags lam pa'i spyod yul yin pa'i phyir ro/ / des na rang gi blo dang 'tshams pa ji ltar nyams su len par 'dod pa'i chos skor re la sogs pa gang yang rung ba zhig ci nus ci lcogs su bslabs pas yon tan gyi tshogs 'phel bar 'gyur zhing sku tshe don dang ldan par 'gyur bas de bzhin mdzod cig / theg chen thun mong ma yin pa'i lam 'bras bu dang bcas pa phyogs mtshon tsam bstan pa la/ lam dang 'bras bu gnyis las/ dang po la/ las dang po pa'i sa bshad pa/ mos pas spyaud pa'i sa bshad pa/ 'phags pa'i sa bshad pa rnams las/ dang po ni/ kun gyi dge ba kun la yi rangs zhing*/ /nyid kyi legs par spyad pa rnam gsum yang*/ /sangs rgyas nyid thob bgyi slad yongs bsngos nas/ / de yang las dang po pa'i gnas skabs su/ theg chen dge ba'i bshes gnyen bsten pa dang*/ bsam pa byang chub tu sems bskyed pa gnyis gzhung tshig gi dngos su bstan kyang shugs la 'phangs pa yin pas/ don thob kyis kha bskang bar bya ste/ dge ba'i bshes gnyen bsten pa ni/ theg pa thun mong gi skabs dge ba'i bshes gnyen bsten pa tshangs par spyod ces sogs gong du bstan pa skabs 'dir yang dgos pa dang*/ sangs rgyas nyid thob bgyi slad ces pa'i zur gyis byang chub tu sems bskyed dgos pa bstan pas/ dge ba'i bshes gnyen bsten pa dang*/ byang chub kyi sems la gnas pa sngon du 'gro bas/ rang gi lus ngag yid gsum gyis legs par spyad pa'i dge ba la brtson pa dang*/ gzhan gyi dge ba la yi rang ba/ yul gyi sgo nas dgra gnyen med pa/ dge ba'i las kyi ngo bo la che chung med par rang gzhan kun gyi dge ba mtha' dag kun la rjes su yi rang bar byed pa dang*/ nyid rang gi sgo gsum gyi legs spyad rnam pa gsum gyis dge ba bsgrubs pa dang*/ gzhan gyi dge ba la rjes su yi rang bar bgyis pa de dag gzhan don du byang chub chen po thob pa'i rgyur bsngo bar byed cing*/

tshig zin la mi gsal yang de dag rnams kyang spros bral stong pa nyid kyi lta bas rgyas 'debs dgos pa yin te/ dge ba thams cad stong nyid kyis zin par byed pa ni theg pa chen po spy-i'i lugs so/ / de ltar theg chen dge ba'i bshes gnyen bstan pa byang chub tu sems bskyed pa/ sgom gsum dge ba la rtsol ba/ gzhan gyi dge ba la rjes su yi rang ba/ gzhan don du dge ba'i rtsa ba byang chub tu bsngo ba/ de rnams stong pa nyid kyis rgyas 'debs pa ste/ chos drug po de ni tshogs lam pa'i nyams len dngos gzhi yin cing*/ sbyor lam du yang de ltar nyams su len kyang*/ tshogs lam du ni ma grub pa 'grub par byed pa'i thams su lam dge la slob cing sbyor lam du grub zin gong du 'phel bar byed pa'o/ /ched gnyer gyis 'bad rtsol mi dgos par rang nyid ngang gis lam gyi nyams len dge ba'i chos mtha' dag 'phel bar 'gyur na tshogs lam rgyud la skyes pa yin no/ /tshogs lam dang*/ las dang po pa'i sa dang*/ dad pa'i sa rnams don gcig go / mos spyaud kyis bshad pa ni/ de nas dge ba'i phung po 'di yis khyod/ /skye ba dpag tu med par lha dang mi'i/ /'jig rten kun gyi rnal 'byor dbang mdzad nas/ /de'i rjes nas tshogs lam du bsod nams rgya chen por bsags pa'i phung po chen po de'i rgyus khyod kyis sbyor lam thob pa na lus rten gyi khyad par dgos pa'i don chen po'i ched du ma gtogs ngan song du mi skye bas/ skye ba dpag tu med pa ste skye ba thams cad du mtho ris lha mi'i lus su 'gyur zhing*/ ting nge 'dzin gyi khyad par 'jig rten pa kun gyi nang tshan pa yin la chos kyi bdag med stong nyid la gsal snang thob pa rnal 'byor du byed pa yang yin pa dang*/ mngon shes la sogs pa thun mong gi yon tan bsgrub pa'i ting nge 'dzin la dbang bsgyur bar byed do/ / de yang 'dod sems rtse gcig pa dang*/

bsam gtan dang*/ gzugs med kyi ting nge 'dzin la brten nas zhi gnas bsgoms pas 'jig rten pa'i sems dang lus rten mtho ris su skye bar bstan pas/ 'jig rten pa'i lam yin pa dang*/ stong pa nyid la gsal snang thob pa'i lhag mthong la rnal 'byor du byed par bshad pas/ tshogs lam las 'das pa'i sbyor lam yin par ston cing*/ chos nyid mngon sum du mthong ba yin pas/ mos pas spyod pa'i sa nyid do/ / 'phags pa'i sa bshad pa ni/ 'phags pa spyan ras gzigs dbang spyod pa yis/ /'gro ba nyams thag mang po rjes bzung ste/ /'khrungs nas na rga 'dod chags zhe sdang rnams/ /byang chub sems dpa' 'phags pa de ni rang don gyi yon tan la/ spangs thob gnyis kyis thob pa'i yon tan ni/ sangs rgyas kyi rigs su 'khrungs pa yin te/ pha bzang po'i tshul dang mthun par bu yang bzang por 'byung pa bzhin du/ chos nyid mngon sum gzigs pa'i thugs rnam pa mthun zhing rigs mtshungs pa dang*/ sku yang byang chub sems dpa' dngos gnas kyi lus/ yin kyi rang bzhin can gyi lus ni mtshan dpes yongs su brgyan pa/ longs spyod rdzogs pa'i sku dang rnam pa mtshungs pa yin no/ / spangs pa'i yon tan ni/ 'dir 'dod chags zhe sdang gnyis mtshon byed du smon pa yin zhing*/ byang chub sems dpa' 'phags pa'i ched du mi spangs pa'i nyon mongs pa dang*/ dbang bsgyur ba'i nyon mongs pa rnams ma gtogs nyon mongs pa mtha' dag spangs shing*/ skye rga na 'chi'i sdug bsngal bzhi rtsa ba nas spangs pa yin te/ byang chub sems dpa' 'phags pa'i dngos gnas kyi lus rdul phra rab kyi chos las 'das pa yid kyi rang bzhin can de la ni/ sdug bsngal bzhi po de dag med de/ khams gsum las yongs su 'das pa'i phyir ro/ /de ltar na yang sprul pa dang smon lam gyi skye ba la sogs pa ston par byed pa yang yin no/ / 'gro ba'i don spyod tshul ni/ 'phags pa spyan ras gzigs kyi slob pa lam gyi gnas skabs su sems can sdug bsngal gyi gnas mtha' dag las skyob par mdzad pa'i spyod pa bzhin du sprul pa sna tshogs pas/

'gro ba sdug bsngal gyis nyams thag par 'gyur ba mang po rnams rjes su bzung ste/ thar ba'i go 'phang la 'god pa'i byang chub sems dpa'i spyaud pa rlabs chen po dang ldan pa yin no/ / theg chen thun mong ma yin pa'i 'bras bu bshad pa la/ zhing khams dang bcas pa'i rten gyi khyad par bshad pa dang*/ 'phrin las bshad pa gnyis kyi dang po ni/ bsal te sangs rgyas zhing du bcom ldan 'das/ /'od dpag med dang 'dra bar 'jig rten gyi/ /mgon po sku tshe dpag tu med par mdzod/ /sngon bskal ba grangs med gsum la sogs par bsod nams dang ye shes kyi tshogs dpag tu med par bsgrubs shing smon lam btab nas/ sangs rgyas kyi zhing yongs su sbyong bar mdzad pas/ sangs rgyas rang snang ye shes kyi zhing khams 'og min stug po bkod pa'i gnas dang*/ gzhan snang du yang bde ba can la sogs pa gang du mngon par rdzogs par sangs rgyas pa'i gnas ni/ 'jig rten gyi khams gzhan las khyad par du 'phags pa bde ba dam pa'i gnas phun sum tshogs pa 'byung zhing*/ rten ni sangs rgyas rang snang gi ye shes kyi sku mtshan dang dpe byad kyis yongs su brgyan pa/ dus chad pa med par rtag tu 'tsho zhing bzhes pa 'khor byang chub sems dpa' sa bcu pa rnams la chos kyi 'khor lo ma lus par rdzogs par bskor ba'i chos yongs su rdzogs par spyod pas longs spyaud rdzogs sku zhes bya zhing*/ bcom ldan 'das 'od dpag tu med pa 'khor ba ji srid gnas kyi bar du 'tsho zhing bzhes pa dang rjes su mthun par/ rgyal po khyod kyis kyang 'jig rten gyi mgon po sku tshe dpag tu med pa dus rtag tu 'pho 'gyur med pa ni longs spyod rdzogs pa'i sku yin pas/ de lta bu'i sangs rgyas kyi go 'phang thob par mdzod cig 'dir dpe'i skabs su bcom ldan 'das zhes pa 'bras bu'i yon tan 'chad par dgongs pa yin te/ 'das zhes pa lha dbang phyug sogs kyi ming dang nor 'khrul byung bar dogs nas lo tsā bas bla thabs su bsnan pa'o/

de yang bha ga bcom pa dang*/ skal ba la 'jug cing*/ wan ldan pa ste/ bcom ldan ni skal ldan du 'gyur bas/ bdud bzhi bcom pa dang*/ skal ba ldan pa ste/ de ltar yang*/ dbang phyug dang ni gzugs bzang dang*/ /dpal dang grags dang ye shes dang*/ /brtson 'grus phun sum tshogs pa ste/ /drug po de la skal zhes bya/ /de yang bsam gtan gyi pha rol tu phyin pa las/ dbang phyug phun sum tshogs pa dang*/ bzod pa'i pha rol tu phyin pa las gzugs phun sum tshogs pa dang*/ sbyin pa'i pha rol tu phyin pa las dpal phun sum tshogs pa dang*/ tshul khrims kyi pha rol tu phyin pa las grags pa phun sum tshogs pa dang*/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa las dus gsum chags thogs med pa'i ye shes phun sum tshogs pa dang*/ brtson 'grus kyi pha rol tu phyin pa las gzhan don 'phrin las phun sum tshogs pa 'bad med du rgyun ma chad par 'byung ba'i brtson 'grus phun sum tshogs pa rnams so/ / 'phrin las bshad pa la/ ngo bo dang dbye ba gnyis las/ dang po ni/ shes rab tshul khrims gtong 'byung grags chen dri ma med/ /lha yul nam mkha' dang ni sa steng rgyas mdzad nas/ /sangs rgyas kyis 'gro ba mtha' dag gi dbang po dang mtshams par chos kyi 'khor lo ma lus par bskor bar mdzad pas/ 'gro ba rnams rnam dkar gyi dge ba'i rtsa ba la 'god par mdzad do/ /shes rab dang*/ tshul khrims dang*/ gtong ba sbyin pa ste/ de rnams ni 'phags pa dgyes pa dang*/ mkhas pas bsngags par bya ba'i yul yin pas/ grags pa chen po 'byung ba dang*/ skyon gyis ma gos pa dri ma med pa ste/ mi dge bas ma gos pa/ nyon mongs pas ma gos pa/ bden 'dzin gyis ma gos pa de lta bu'i dge ba'i rtsa ba lha yul dang*/ nam mkha' gnod sbyin rgyu ba'i gnas dang*/ sa steng gi yul dang*/ dpe mtshon nas/ sa 'og gi klu la sogs pa srid pa gsum gyi 'jig rten du rgyas par mdzod cig / dbye ba la/

mtho ris kyi bde ba la 'god pa/ nyan thos dang rang sangs rgyas kyi thar pa la 'god pa/ sangs rgyas kyi byang chub la 'god pa rnams ston pa las/ mtho ris kyi bde ba la 'god pa ni/ sa la mi dang mtho ris lha ni na chung mchog /bde dge dga' ba nges par rab tu zhi/ /sa la mi'i tshor ba sdug bsngal gyi tshogs rnams nye bar zhi ba'i dga' bde dang*/ mtho ris lha ni lha'i na chung ma dang rtse ba la sogs pa'i bde ba rgyas par byed pa dang*/ nges par tshor ba sdug bsngal rab tu zhi bar byed pa ni mtho ris kyi bde ba la 'god pa'o/ /de yang thar pa'i skal ba med pa mtho ris tsam la 'god pa dang*/ skal ldan gyi thar pa'i lam stegs su mtho ris la 'god pa gnyis yod do/ / nyan rang gi thar pa la 'god pa na/ nyon mongs nyam thag sems can tshogs kyi 'jigs bskyed dang*/ 'chi ba zhi mdzad nyon mongs kyi nyam thag pa'i sems can rnams la thar pa'i lam bstan pas/ 'jigs pa skye ba dang*/ 'chi ba rnams zhi bar mdzad pa ste/ na ba/ rgas pa/ mi sdug pa dang phrad pa dang*/ 'dod pa btsal gyis mi rnyed pa la sogs pa de rnams nye bar zhi ba nyan rang gi byang chub la 'god pa la/ 'di ni thar pa'i skal ba yod kyang re zhig sangs rgyas thob pa'i skal ba med pa rnams kyi don du'o/ / sangs rgyas kyi byang chub la 'god pani/ rgyal ba'i dbang po nyid brnyes nas/ /'jig rten las 'das ming tsam zhi ba mi g.yo ba/ /mi bgres rmongs pa mi mnga'i go 'phang brnyes par mdzod/ /'di na rigs nges ma nges ji ltar yang theg chen pa'i skal ba can rnams te/ rgyal ba yang yin la dbang po yang yin te/ 'jig rten gyi 'dren pa dbang po yin pa'i phyir ro/ /de lta bu'i go 'phang brnyes par byas pa ni 'jig rten las 'das pa yin no/ /nyan rang 'phags pa rnams kyang 'jig rten las 'das pa ma yin nam ce na/ de dag ni rags pa tsam gyi dbang du byas nas 'jig rten las 'das pa yin yang*/

de dag la ni ma rig bag chags kyi sa dang*/ zag med kyi las dang*/ yid kyi rang bzhin can gyi lus dang*/ bsam gyis mi khyab pa'i chos 'chi 'pho ba dang*/ skye ba yod pas na/ 'khor ba'i nyon mongs pa'i zhad ma dag pa cung zad yod pas/ 'jig rten las shin tu 'das pa ni ma yin no/ / sangs rgyas kyi sku gsung thugs mdzad pa 'phrin las rnams/ gzhan gyi spyaud yul du ma gyur pa'i ming tsam gyis ston pa yin cing*/ spang bya sgrib sogs mtha' dag nye bar zhi ba dang*/ mi g.yo ba rtag pa'i sku ste/ de ni phung po 'gyur nas bgres par mi 'gyur/ nongs pa ste mi rtag pa'i tshul bstan pa mya ngan las 'das par mi 'gyur zhing de dag mi mnga' ba/ longs spyod rdzogs pa'i sku'i go 'phangs brnyes par mdzod cig /ces gdams pa'i tshul gyis gdul bya sangs rgyas la 'god pa'i 'phrin las bstan pa'o/ / gzhung mthar phyin pa'i don ni gsum ste/ bstan bcos kyi mtshan smos pa ni/ bshes pa'i 'phrin yig slob dpon chen po 'phags pa klu sgrub kyis rgyal po bde spyaud bzang po la bskur ba rdzogs so// // 'gyur byang ni rgya gar gyi mkhan po sarba dz+nyā de ba dang*/ zhu chen gyi lo tsā ba ban+dhe dpal brtsegs kyis bsgyur cing gtan la phab pa'o/ /'gyur gyi yon bdag la gdams pa ni/ dge gshes klu yis gdams pa'i char rgyun 'dis*/ / mi rje rgyal po'i thugs kyi mtsho rgyas nas/ /rgyal srid 'khor gyi nya sbal mang po dag /skyabs mdzad re ba yid bzhin skong bar smon/ /phyi ma gnyis ni 'gyur byed lo tsā bas sbyar ba'o/ / de ltar 'phags pa klu sgrub kyi/ /gsung gi bdud rtsi'i nying khu yis/ /bde spyaud rgyal po smin mdzad ltar/ /gdams ngag gsung gi bdag don rnyed/ /tshul 'di sa spyod kun gyi gtso/ /rgyal thabs kun las rnam rgyal bas/ /don gnyer kun la phan pa dang*/ /'phags pa'i mchog kun dgyes phyir sbyar/ /de ltar chos don dri med nyi ma'i snang ba yis/

/'gro 'di rgud pa'i mun pa bsal te theg mchog lam/ /gegs med mngon gyur rang gzhan don gnyis lhun grub ste/ / 'gyur med mchog gi sku yi 'gro don rgyas gyur cig / ces slob dpon chen po 'phags pa klu sgrub gyis mdzad pa'i bshes pa'i 'phrin yig zhes bya ba'i ṭīk+ka 'di ni/ rje btsun thams cad mkhyen pa tā ra nā tha'i zhal lung ji lta ba bzhin sa skyong kun gyi dbang phyug /gtsang sde srid phun tshogs rnam rgyal gyis zin bris su bgyis pa yin pas/ 'dis kyang kun mkhyen jo nang pa'i bstan pa rgyas pa'i rgyur gyur cig/// sarba maṅgalaṃ// mes po'i shul bzhag las/ tā ra nā tha'i gsung 'bum/tā ra nā tha'i gsung thor bu'i skor/ - PAGE 262 -- PAGE 261 -- PAGE 194 -
